title: Valuables that are also tools
summary: Several of the valuables in R.E.P.O. are devices rather than ornaments: a flamethrower and an extinguisher run on fuel, a jackhammer makes dust, and the ice saw and the barrel trap anyone who disturbs them.
body: Not every valuable in R.E.P.O. only sits there waiting to be carried. Several of them are tools, and the game keeps them as valuables with a device inside, so what makes one worth money is also what makes it useful.

A flamethrower is one of them. It has a fuel timer, a trigger mesh and emitters that mark where the flame ends, along with a sound for when it runs empty, which is why it can be spent rather than only carried around.

A fire extinguisher works the same way. It uses the same kinds of parts — a fuel timer, a trigger and flame emitters — so putting out a fire depends on how much is left in the device rather than on a switch that is on or off.

A jackhammer is a valuable that makes a mess. It has its own start, end and looping sounds with an impact loop, a collider, and particles for dirt and for dust, so breaking something open is a noisy job the game has modelled rather than a single animation.

Some of them are traps as well as loot. The ice saw is a trap that happens to be worth taking: it has a triggered state and an active state, a timer that turns it on, a blade with a curve and a speed of its own, spark particles, a collider that hurts, and a level of rarity that decides how likely it is to go off at all.
A barrel is in the same position. It is a trap valuable rather than a plain object, which is why disturbing one is a decision rather than a formality.
Others play music. There is a musical valuable with a set of keys, an octave range, a volume and a pitch shift, so a valuable can be something you play rather than only something you carry.
One of them is a way of looking around. The crystal ball keeps a looping sound, an aim direction and a camera position of its own.

What can be played is arranged as well. A musical valuable keeps its own first and last key along with an amount for the low notes, which is why the sound it makes is a set rather than whatever you happen to press.
The images beside this entry are the game's own: the jackhammer and the fire extinguisher that the game itself files as valuables.
What this entry does not tell you: what any of these is worth, how much fuel one holds, or how likely a trap valuable is to trigger. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The ice saw is a trap as well as a valuable, with triggered and active states, a timer and a rarity level for triggering.
facts.evidence: identifiers: IceSawValuable, trapTriggered, trapActive, triggerOnTimer, trapActivateRarityLevel

The musical valuable keeps its own keys, octave range, volume and pitch shift.
